--- a/orgos/agile/benchmark.py
+++ b/orgos/agile/benchmark.py
@@ -83,3 +83,54 @@ def pytest_stats(pytest_output: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
     m = re.search(r"(\d+) failed", pytest_output or "")
     failed = int(m.group(1)) if m else 0
     return passed + failed, passed, failed
+
+
+def summarize_runs(runs: list[BenchmarkRun]) -> dict:
+    """Summarize a list of BenchmarkRun entries.
+
+    Returns a dict with keys: n, total_cost_usd, total_tokens,
+    avg_quality, commit_rate.
+
+    Args:
+        runs: List of BenchmarkRun objects.
+
+    Returns:
+        Summary dict as described.
+    """
+    n = len(runs)
+    if n == 0:
+        return {
+            "n": 0,
+            "total_cost_usd": 0.0,
+            "total_tokens": 0,
+            "avg_quality": None,
+            "commit_rate": 0.0,
+        }
+
+    total_cost_usd = round(sum(r.cost_usd for r in runs), 4)
+    total_tokens = int(sum(r.tokens_total for r in runs))
+
+    # Flat mean of all non-None quality_ac, quality_code, quality_tests
+    quality_values = []
+    for r in runs:
+        if r.quality_ac is not None:
+            quality_values.append(r.quality_ac)
+        if r.quality_code is not None:
+            quality_values.append(r.quality_code)
+        if r.quality_tests is not None:
+            quality_values.append(r.quality_tests)
+
+    avg_quality = None
+    if quality_values:
+        avg_quality = sum(quality_values) / len(quality_values)
+
+    commit_count = sum(1 for r in runs if r.commit_produced)
+    commit_rate = round(commit_count / n, 3) if n > 0 else 0.0
+
+    return {
+        "n": n,
+        "total_cost_usd": total_cost_usd,
+        "total_tokens": total_tokens,
+        "avg_quality": avg_quality,
+        "commit_rate": commit_rate,
+    }
diff --git a/tests/agile/test_summarize_runs.py b/tests/agile/test_summarize_runs.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3afc029
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/agile/test_summarize_runs.py
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+"""Tests for summarize_runs in orgos/agile/benchmark.py."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from orgos.agile.benchmark import BenchmarkRun, summarize_runs
+
+
+def make_run(
+    commit_produced: bool = False,
+    quality_ac: int | None = None,
+    quality_code: int | None = None,
+    quality_tests: int | None = None,
+    cost_usd: float = 0.0,
+    tokens_total: int = 0,
+) -> BenchmarkRun:
+    return BenchmarkRun(
+        issue_id="test",
+        approach="team",
+        model="gpt-4",
+        started_at="2026-01-01T00:00:00",
+        wall_seconds=10.0,
+        tokens_input=0,
+        tokens_output=0,
+        tokens_total=tokens_total,
+        cost_usd=cost_usd,
+        commit_produced=commit_produced,
+        commit_sha="",
+        files_changed=0,
+        loc_added=0,
+        loc_removed=0,
+        tests_run=0,
+        tests_passed=0,
+        tests_failed=0,
+        quality_ac=quality_ac,
+        quality_code=quality_code,
+        quality_tests=quality_tests,
+        quality_summary="",
+        diff_text="",
+    )
+
+
+class TestAC1_ReturnKeys:
+    def test_returns_expected_keys(self) -> None:
+        result = summarize_runs([make_run()])
+        expected_keys = {"n", "total_cost_usd", "total_tokens", "avg_quality", "commit_rate"}
+        assert set(result.keys()) == expected_keys
+
+
+class TestAC2_EmptyList:
+    def test_empty_list_returns_defaults(self) -> None:
+        result = summarize_runs([])
+        assert result == {
+            "n": 0,
+            "total_cost_usd": 0.0,
+            "total_tokens": 0,
+            "avg_quality": None,
+            "commit_rate": 0.0,
+        }
+
+
+class TestAC3_AvgQuality:
+    def test_flat_mean_of_non_none_qualities(self) -> None:
+        runs = [
+            make_run(quality_ac=10, quality_code=20, quality_tests=None),
+            make_run(quality_ac=None, quality_code=30, quality_tests=40),
+        ]
+        result = summarize_runs(runs)
+        # values: 10, 20, 30, 40 -> mean = 25.0
+        assert result["avg_quality"] == 25.0
+
+    def test_all_none_returns_none(self) -> None:
+        runs = [
+            make_run(quality_ac=None, quality_code=None, quality_tests=None),
+            make_run(quality_ac=None, quality_code=None, quality_tests=None),
+        ]
+        result = summarize_runs(runs)
+        assert result["avg_quality"] is None
+
+
+class TestAC4_CommitRate:
+    def test_commit_rate_rounded_3dp(self) -> None:
+        runs = [
+            make_run(commit_produced=True),
+            make_run(commit_produced=True),
+            make_run(commit_produced=False),
+        ]
+        result = summarize_runs(runs)
+        # 2/3 = 0.666...
+        assert result["commit_rate"] == round(2 / 3, 3)
+        assert isinstance(result["commit_rate"], float)
+
+
+class TestAC5_RoundingAndTypes:
+    def test_total_cost_rounded_4dp(self) -> None:
+        runs = [
+            make_run(cost_usd=1.23456),
+            make_run(cost_usd=2.34567),
+        ]
+        result = summarize_runs(runs)
+        # 1.23456 + 2.34567 = 3.58023 -> round to 4dp = 3.5802
+        expected = round(1.23456 + 2.34567, 4)
+        assert result["total_cost_usd"] == expected
+        assert isinstance(result["total_cost_usd"], float)
+
+    def test_total_tokens_is_int(self) -> None:
+        runs = [
+            make_run(tokens_total=1500),
+            make_run(tokens_total=2500),
+        ]
+        result = summarize_runs(runs)
+        assert result["total_tokens"] == 4000
+        assert isinstance(result["total_tokens"], int)
